name: norm_eq_of_addVal
source: private theorem norm_eq_of_addVal {l : ℕ} [Fact l.Prime] {x y : ℤ_[l]}
(h : IsDiscreteValuationRing.addVal ℤ_[l] x = IsDiscreteValuationRing.addVal ℤ_[l] y) :
assume: Assume `IsDiscreteValuationRing.addVal ℤ_[l] x = IsDiscreteValuationRing.addVal ℤ_[l] y` (h).
show: Two ℓ-adic integers with equal extended additive valuations have equal norms.
strategy: Recover divisibility in each direction from equality of valuations. Apply the divisibility bound for the norm twice.

steps.claim: Equality of the extended additive valuations gives $v_\ell(x)\le v_\ell(y)$, hence $x\mid y$ by the discrete valuation ring's divisibility criterion.
The reverse inequality $v_\ell(y)\le v_\ell(x)$ follows from the same equality and gives $y\mid x$.
From $y\mid x$ one has $\lVert x\rVert\le\lVert y\rVert$, while $x\mid y$ gives $\lVert y\rVert\le\lVert x\rVert$. Antisymmetry proves equality, also when the common valuation is infinite.

chapterTitle: Twisted cokernels in a cyclotomic tower
